scope: Preview and variant flags only: URL flags that pick between built variants of a feature for this load, ever added. Every other URL flag the game reads is listed under normal and is not a preview flag. A new name read from the URL needs an entry in one of the two lists (tools/check-flags.mjs, run by the land check).
rules: status open: the flag needs an item (a CHE key) or a question for the owner, and src still reads it.
status picked: the owner decided, pickRef says where, and nothing in src reads the flag any more (test/flags.mjs).
